- **The action no longer installs git hooks in the target repository** (#38, fixed in #41). Before this fix, pi-action installed its own \`commit-msg\` hook (pi-action's Conventional Commit types) and \`prepare-commit-msg\` hook (appends \`Refs #<n>\`) in every repository it ran in. That rejected commits that follow other conventions, such as \`release: v0.35.1\`. pi now follows the repository's own conventions.
